name: Player monster (waves)
notes: The monster the human picked on the second half of the menu (the waves mode), its species from 'chosen'. It fights exactly like in the classic run: D-pad walks in 8 directions, A / B / R fire moves 1-3 (move 2 unlocks at level 4, move 3 at level 7), the same walking dodge, the same home-world bonus and the same sounds; START opens the waves pause menu. What differs: it is held inside the lit floor by the arena's dark edge, no floor items lie on the ground when the run starts (the wave monsters drop them instead: 25% of the faints, at most 3 of each item per run), and every level gained first freezes the whole game for half a second (LV UP! over the monster, the level-up sound, the HUD showing the new level, the refilled HP and the reset XP bar) and then opens the level-up menu (menu_power), one level at a time, to choose 1 of 3 cards (power, speed, aim, dodge, recharge, max HP). Levels: 1 XP per hit and the wave monsters' XP when they faint; a level costs 20 XP, then 12 more for each level plus 6 more again each time (20, 38, 62, 92, 128 ... a steepening curve, because later waves bring many more monsters), up to level 25. HP starts at 60 (Furrbit: 72, its species' hp_bonus); each level still adds 8 max HP and heals it to full. When its HP runs out the run ends (the waves game over screen). A shiny monster (its slot of 'shiny' is set: one more every 5 different runs won) shimmers through the rainbow in every animation (its moves' effects keep their colors), its moves hit 10% harder (power 100% becomes 110%, before the boosts) and it starts the run with 20% more HP (60 becomes 72; Furrbit's 72 becomes 86). When a wild monster's move hurts a shiny one it blinks red 3 times, like the wild monsters do, instead of the white flash, so the hit shows over the rainbow.
